rationale: OnPoint resolves to OnPoint Energy, LLC, an ArcLight-sponsored U.S. retail-electricity platform formed in 2022 rather than a power-generation fleet. Direct regulatory evidence shows that it transferred all customers, ceased providing retail electric service, cancelled its remaining federal market-based-rate tariff effective 2024-01-31, and later lost its Texas retail electric provider certificate. ArcLight still lists OnPoint as a current Power investment, supporting retained ownership of a residual or wind-down entity rather than a currently operating manager-level infrastructure platform. It should therefore be excluded from the active operating-company census.

identityResolution.platformBoundary: Manager-level retail-electricity platform represented by OnPoint Energy, LLC. Regulated activity was conducted through same-name affiliates including OnPoint Energy Texas, LLC and federal market-based-rate entities for Illinois, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and the Northeast. Direct sources identify a retail supplier and energy-marketing platform, not an owned power-generation fleet. The regulated affiliates are subsidiaries or operating entities beneath the same manager-level platform and should not be counted separately.
identityResolution.duplicateDecision: OnPoint Energy is distinct from Onward Energy. FERC records list the OnPoint entities and Onward Energy Management, LLC under separate legal names and identifiers, and no opened source established an alias, predecessor, successor, merger, or ownership relationship between them.

operatingResolution.subsector: Retail electricity supply and energy marketing
operatingResolution.description: Former ArcLight-sponsored retail electric provider created to offer electricity plans to residential, commercial, and industrial customers, initially in ERCOT, and to support commercial optimization of ArcLight's broader power portfolio.
operatingResolution.services: Retail electricity enrollment, pricing, billing, account management, customer service, and related energy-marketing activities.
operatingResolution.footprint: Commercial operations were directly confirmed in Texas/ERCOT. Illinois, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Northeast affiliates made federal market-based-rate filings, but the opened sources did not establish a commercial customer launch outside Texas. The remaining federal tariff was cancelled effective 2024-01-31.

acquisitionExitCheck.formationOrAcquisition: ArcLight announced the formation of OnPoint Energy, LLC and a $50 million commitment to retail initiatives on 2022-08-17. No predecessor acquisition was publicly disclosed in the opened sources.
acquisitionExitCheck.legalClosing: NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED. No separate legal-closing announcement was identified in the opened evidence; transaction counsel described the matter as an ArcLight investment on 2022-08-19.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: Opened regulatory evidence shows that OnPoint agreed on 2024-01-30 to sell or transfer its Texas customer contracts and customer lists to Good Charlie, subsequently stated that it had transferred all customers and was no longer providing retail electric service, cancelled its remaining federal market-based-rate tariff effective 2024-01-31, and later had Texas REP certificate 10326 revoked. The opened evidence did not show a sale of OnPoint Energy, LLC itself, a merger, rename, dissolution, bankruptcy, or a signed pending parent-level ownership transaction through 2026-08-14. ArcLight's live investments page continued to label OnPoint as a current Power investment.

milestones.event: ArcLight announced the launch of OnPoint Energy, LLC, a Houston-headquartered retail electric provider initially focused on ERCOT, and committed $50 million to retail initiatives.
OnPoint's Illinois, Ohio, and Pennsylvania entities filed initial FERC market-based-rate applications.
OnPoint agreed to sell or transfer its Texas customer contracts and customer lists to Good Charlie.
The remaining OnPoint federal market-based-rate tariff was cancelled effective this date.
PUCT materials reported final action revoking OnPoint Energy Texas, LLC's retail electric provider certificate 10326.

The residual parent entity's current state-law good-standing or dissolution status and any remaining non-customer assets or liabilities are NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED.

recommendedListAction: Exclude OnPoint Energy from the active manager-level operating-company census as a non-operating wind-down or residual holding. Retain it only as a historical or current-unrealized record if the data model tracks dormant residual investments. Do not map it to Onward Energy or Good Charlie, and do not count the OnPoint regulatory affiliates separately.
